## History

Aaron brought a pair of china dogs from [London](../codex/places.md#london) to place by the hearth, where they remained undisturbed for decades. He eventually served as the namesake for [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). Before his passing, he bequeathed his property to his sister [Tabby](../character/tabby.md), after which it became known as Tabby's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)_
